newsitem.title: USA: Scansource withdraws 2.0 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Scansource withdraws 2.0 mln share offer.

text.p: ScanSource Inc said Monday it was withdrawing its proposed public offering of 2.0 million shares.
Steve Owings, ScanSource chairman and chief executive officer, said the company concluded it would not be in the best interest of shareholders to sell its stock at current market prices.
"Management believes the company has sufficient resources at this time to continue its growth strategy without the offering," he said.
ScanSource will evaluate its position again if market conditions improve, he said.

ScanSource is a wholesale distributor of automatic-identification and point-of-sale products that interface with computer systems used to automate the collection, processing and communication of information for commercial and industrial applications.
